title: Teodoro to raise South China Sea and Thailand-Cambodia disputes in ASEAN meetings
summary: Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro, who is leading the 20th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ meeting in Cebu on Wednesday, said that the issue of the South China Sea would be part of discussions.
